query: SELECT world.generation_stage, world.initial_prompt, world.storyteller_summary, world_generation.questions, world_generation.next_question, world_generation.spent, world_generation.questioner_branch_id, world_generation.storyteller_branch_id, questioner.agent_id AS questioner_agent_id, storyteller.agent_id AS storyteller_agent_id FROM world JOIN world_generation ON world_generation.world_id = world.id JOIN world_role_agent AS questioner ON questioner.world_id = world.id AND questioner.role = 'questioner' JOIN world_role_agent AS storyteller ON storyteller.world_id = world.id AND storyteller.role = 'storyteller' WHERE world.id = ?
